description: The .env file of the Bundle root is read for AGSC_* names only, after the process environment and before the project configuration (AGSC-01-37, AGSC-09-09): the process value 3 beats the file's 7 for the node cap, the file's AGSC_BUILD_OUT beats the configuration, a non-AGSC_ line and a comment are ignored, and ci prints the names in effect, never the values.

input.env_file:
# local overrides
AGSC_BUDGET_USD_MONTH=7
AGSC_BUILD_OUT=www-next
OPENAI_API_KEY=not-read
AGSC_MODEL_API_KEY=secret-value

note: added 2026-09-18 at rc.4 (D88); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.4 tag
